news_items.headline: Middleby agrees to sell 51% stake in Residential Kitchen business to 26North affiliates ($885M valuation)
news_items.summary: Middleby entered a definitive agreement to sell a majority stake in its Residential Kitchen segment to affiliates of 26North in a deal valuing the business at $885M, part of an ongoing strategic portfolio review to sharpen focus on Commercial Foodservice.

news_items.headline: Middleby advancing Midera Food Processing spin-off; completion expected early July 2026
news_items.summary: Food Processing segment to separate into standalone public company Midera Food Processing Inc. via share distribution to existing holders; completion targeted early July 2026 pending regulatory approval.

news_items.headline: Middleby Investor Day scheduled to lay out post-spin strategic vision
news_items.summary: Upcoming Investor Day cited as a near-term catalyst where management lays out long-term vision for the streamlined Commercial Foodservice business and the independent Food Processing platform.
